{title}

{title}

{body}
""" def publish_blog_article(subject: str, description: str) -> str: """ Safely formats a user-submitted blog post for display on a web page. Parameters ---------- subject : str The title of the blog post. description : str The main body text of the blog post. Returns ------- str A sanitized and formatted HTML snippet ready for safe display. """ # Escape any HTML special characters to prevent XSS escaped_title = html.escape(subject, quote=True) escaped_body = html.escape(description, quote=True) # Format using the predefined template formatted_post = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=escaped_title, body=escaped_body) return formatted_post
